stem:
The random variable $X$ has probability density function, f, given by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{1}{x^2} & a < x < b, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $a$ and $b$ are positive constants.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
It is given that $\text{E}(X) = \ln 2$.

Show that $b = 2a$.
